name: math-research-workflow
description: Orchestrates the full mathematics research pipeline: program management (manage-math-research-program) to rigorous problem research (rigorous-open-math-research) to Lean formal verification (lean-verify), with sub-agent division of labor, artifact handoff contracts, hash binding, and automatic git sync at every stage boundary.

interface.shortDescription: 管理-研究-验证一体化数学研究流水线编排(manage + rigorous + lean-verify).
interface.longDescription: One orchestrator for the three-skill pipeline: stage A program management and task packets, stage B rigorous problem research with solver/audit sub-agents, stage C Lean formalization with machine verification and obligation-level audits. Enforces handoff contracts, honest status labels, and git sync at every stage boundary.
interface.defaultPrompt: 帮我跑一个数学项目的研究+验证全流程(管理-研究-Lean形式化).
